## 🏭 Factory Floor OEE & Bottleneck Intelligence Tracker
**Architecture & Capabilities:**
1. **Telemetry & State Tracking:** Continuous ingestion of state transitions (Running, Idle, Faulted) with automatic micro-stop (<300s) isolation.
2. **Shift Metric Engine:** SEMI E10 & ISO 22400 compliant OEE (Availability × Performance × Quality) with edge-case guards.
3. **AI Root-Cause Synthesis:** Normalizes unstructured operator logs into ISA-95 categories and isolates primary bottlenecks via Theory of Constraints.
4. **Executive Handover:** Dispatches automated industrial shift handover reports with actionable CAPA items via Telegram & Webhook.

### 1. Ingestion & State Tracking
- Trigger: Scheduled shift end (06:00, 14:00, 22:00) or Live Webhook
- Tracks discrete operating states: RUNNING, IDLE, FAULTED
- Detects & segregates micro-stops (<5 min) from major breakdowns

### 2. ISO 22400 OEE Engine
- Availability: Operating Time / Planned Production Time
- Performance: (Ideal Cycle Time × Total Parts) / Operating Time
- Quality: Good Parts / Total Parts
- OEE: A × P × Q with Zero-Output & Data-Gap protection

### 3. AI Root-Cause Synthesis
- Deduplicates informal operator log notes
- Standardizes into ISA-95 root cause categories
- Pinpoints primary operational bottleneck
- Generates prioritized CAPA action items

### 4. Executive Handover & Dispatch
- Generates structured Markdown & HTML reports
- Dispatches instant alert to Plant Management on Telegram
- Returns rich JSON payload for MES/ERP systems

// 4. EXECUTIVE SHIFT REPORT & NOTIFICATION DISPATCHER // Formats high-impact industrial shift handover reports in Markdown and HTML. const item = $input.first().json; const meta = item.meta || {}; const time = item.time_tracking || {}; const oee = item.oee_metrics || {}; const counts = item.production_counts || {}; const pareto = item.pareto_analysis || {}; const ai = item.ai_synthesis || {}; // Format concise Markdown for Telegram & Mobile Push const telegramMarkdown = `*FACTORY SHIFT HANDOVER: OEE & BOTTLENECK REPORT* *Line:* \`${meta.line_name}\` *Shift ID:* \`${meta.shift_id}\` | *Supervisor:* ${meta.supervisor} *EXECUTIVE OEE SCORECARD:* - *Overall OEE:* *${oee.oee_percent}%* (${oee.benchmark_badge}) - *Availability:* ${oee.availability_percent}% (${time.operating_minutes}m / ${time.planned_production_minutes}m) - *Performance:* ${oee.performance_percent}% (${counts.total_count} units produced) - *Quality:* ${oee.quality_percent}% (${counts.good_parts_count} good / ${counts.scrap_parts_count} scrap) *TIME LOSS & MICRO-STOP BREAKDOWN:* - *Total Unplanned Downtime:* ${time.total_unplanned_downtime_minutes} min - *Micro-Stops (<5 min):* ${time.micro_stop_count} events = *${time.micro_downtime_minutes} min* (${time.micro_stop_loss_percentage}% of loss) - *Major Breakdowns:* ${time.macro_stop_count} events = ${time.macro_downtime_minutes} min - *MTBF:* ${oee.mtbf_minutes} min | *MTTR:* ${oee.mttr_minutes} min *BOTTLENECK & PARETO ATTRIBUTION:* - *Primary Constraint:* *${pareto.primary_bottleneck_station}* (${pareto.bottleneck_lost_minutes} min lost) ${pareto.ranking ? pareto.ranking.slice(0, 3).map((r, i) => ` ${i + 1}. ${r.category}: ${r.lost_minutes}m (${r.percentage_of_downtime}%)`).join("\n") : ""} *AI SHIFT DIRECTIVES & CAPA:* ${ai.report_text ? ai.report_text.split("### 3. Prioritized CAPA Action Plan")[1]?.split("### 4.")[0]?.trim() || "See detailed shift log for full action items." : "Review line maintenance logs."} _Dispatched automatically by Industrial Automation OEE Intelligence Engine._`; // Format full HTML report for MES/Email distribution const htmlReport = `

Factory Floor OEE & Bottleneck Intelligence Report

Line: ${meta.line_name} | Shift: ${meta.shift_id} | Supervisor: ${meta.supervisor}

Overall OEE
${oee.oee_percent}%
${oee.benchmark}
Availability
${oee.availability_percent}%
${time.operating_minutes} / ${time.planned_production_minutes} min
Performance
${oee.performance_percent}%
${counts.total_count} parts (1.2s ICT)
Quality
${oee.quality_percent}%
${counts.scrap_parts_count} scrap (${oee.scrap_rate_percent}%)

Time Loss & Micro-Stop Breakdown

Downtime Category Incident Count Lost Minutes % of Loss
Micro-Stops (< 5 min) ${time.micro_stop_count} ${time.micro_downtime_minutes} min ${time.micro_stop_loss_percentage}%
Major Breakdowns (≥ 5 min) ${time.macro_stop_count} ${time.macro_downtime_minutes} min ${(100 - time.micro_stop_loss_percentage).toFixed(1)}%

AI Bottleneck & Root-Cause Synthesis

${ai.report_text}
`; return [ { json: { ...item, executive_report: { telegram_markdown: telegramMarkdown, html_markup: htmlReport, dispatched_at: new Date().toISOString() } } } ];
